checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: daily challenge with UTC-day ruleset (operator/weapon/map/difficulty/mode/mutator) and fixed seed, daily screen with ruleset and best, per-day best map pruned to 30 days, daily HUD flag, DAILY DRIVER and DAILY ACE achievements, setDay seam, menu 2-column grid, help compacted for 19 lines; 105/105 tests, 5/5 gates, layout/determinism/prune/lastSeed probes OK; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-17' completed successfully.

[1/5] Plan: v0.18 visual pass - cache procedural ground tiles and vignette gradients, distinct silhouettes for priority mobs, shape-coded boss affixes, fix WYRM burrow render bug, framerate-independent particle drag, harness draw-op counters plus op-budget tests

impact_assessment.why: The visual audit found the ground pass costs 442 paths and 281 ellipses every frame with no enemies on screen, 19 mobs share one circular silhouette so priority threats do not read, boss affixes differ only by colour, and the WYRM renders an underground mound at 10px because burrowT is never set
impact_assessment.benefits: Large constant per-frame saving, readable threat priority, affix meaning visible without colour, correct mega-boss underground read, and regression tests that measure draw operations instead of pixels
impact_assessment.risks: contract: render internals change and the test harness gains op counters; dependency: none, offscreen canvases use the same Canvas 2D API; concurrency: ledger shared; state: none, no save-schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep a full-redraw fallback when offscreen canvases are unavailable, preserve all existing draw order, assert op budgets and existing suite, full gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Implementation and verification complete: cached ground tiles (8 variants/map, offscreen, redraw fallback), cached vignette, 2x DPR backing store, distinct silhouettes for 9 priority mobs, shape-coded affix glyphs, WYRM mound fix, framerate-independent particle drag, harness draw-op counters; 110/110 tests, 5/5 gates, profiled 1857->348 ops idle (-81%) and 4584->3075 at 150 mobs, script cost 0.82->0.19ms idle, 3.73->1.92ms at cap; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-18' completed successfully.

[1/4] Plan: v0.19 screenshot-driven visual QA - soften seamless ground and hazards, fix statistics, armory, setup map and HUD/pause layout collisions, add text-layout regression capture, verify with fresh shots and the project gate

impact_assessment.why: Fresh canvas screenshots of the menu, setup, armory, statistics, manual, HUD, pause, level-up, relic and boss states show ground-tile seams and hard-edged hazard blobs, a statistics section drawn over the last stat row, armory NEED text and rank pips colliding with rows, a selected map card rendered dimmer than unselected cards, an alert label straddling the timer panel, and a PAUSED title over the boss bar
impact_assessment.benefits: Cleaner terrain and hazard readability on every map, no overlapping layout text on three screens, a clear selected-map state, a calm pause overlay, and harness-level text-position tests that pin these visual regressions
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rendering helpers and HUD text positions change, but snapshot, save schema and mechanics stay unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep draw order and existing draw-op budgets, cache hazard sprites instead of adding per-frame gradients, add a harness fillText recorder with focused layout assertions, rerun all 110 tests plus new tests, capture before/after screenshots, then run python aikit.py check dustline

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Rendering polish: ground variants now share one base colour with low-alpha patches, cracks and specks so cached 140px tiles no longer seam; hazards render from a per-map cached 256px radial sprite with a faint rim and a fallback ellipse, replacing flat hard-edged pools; verified by a new drawImage/fill layout recorder in the harness

[3/4] Layout and regression tests complete: statistics kills-by-type block moved below the stat grid, armory rank pips and NEED text moved inside each row, selected setup map now uses the lighter overlay, timer panel contains the alert label/bar, boss bar moved below it, pause hides combat readouts and live banners with the title at y=128; added opt-in fillText/fill/rect/drawImage recorder and 7 tests (ground base, soft hazards, statistics, armory, setup map, alert, pause); 117/117 tests pass

[4/4] Verification complete: 117/117 tests pass, python aikit.py check dustline reports 5/5 gates, and fresh canvas captures of menu, setup, statistics, armory, all four maps, a hazard centre and the pause overlay confirm seamless ground, visible soft hazards with rims, fixed statistics/armory/HUD layout, a clear selected map and a collision-free pause; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-19' completed successfully.

[1/4] Plan: v0.20 visual juice pass - biome ambience particles, shaped combat particles (spark/smoke/shard/ring/flash), muzzle and bullet glow, dash afterimages, low-health danger vignette, skill/relic card glyphs and animated button hover

impact_assessment.why: The v0.19 pass fixed seams, hazards and layout, but screenshots still show flat biome atmosphere, one-note circular particles, a sparse level-up/relic card interior, no dash trail, and no persistent low-health warning; the game needs another visual layer that reinforces map identity and combat feedback
impact_assessment.benefits: Distinct desert/frost/ash/jungle atmosphere, readable shot/hit/death/pickup feedback, stronger skill and relic identity on choice cards, a clear dash trail and danger state, all procedural and within the existing draw budgets
impact_assessment.risks: contract: particle objects and render helpers change, snapshot gains read-only particles/afterimages/ambience data, no save-schema or mechanics change; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cap every particle family, keep ambience screen-space and deterministic, reuse cached canvases for danger glow, add particle-kind and afterimage tests, rerun the full suite and draw budgets, compare fresh screenshots, then run python aikit.py check dustline

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Particle and effect layer complete: deterministic biome ambience for all four maps, shape-coded particle kinds (dot/spark/smoke/shard/ring/flash/glow) with additive highlights, muzzle flash and glowing bullet trails, impact sparks, shard/smoke deaths, explosion rings, dash afterimages and a cached low-health red vignette plus pulsing border; new cosmetic bursts use a separate run-seeded fx RNG so the gameplay RNG stream stays unchanged

[3/4] UI and card graphics complete: procedural skill glyphs on level-up cards and the codex, relic glyphs on salvage cards, animated hover pulse/glow on buttons, spread floaters with a text shadow, README and package 0.20.0 updated, ADR-020 recorded; 121/121 tests pass

[4/4] Verification complete: 121/121 tests pass, python aikit.py check dustline reports 5/5 gates, fresh canvas captures and the v0.20 contact sheet confirm hover glow, codex/level-up/relic glyphs, all four biome ambience modes, dash afterimages, low-health warning and shaped explosion particles; particle cap and 7,000-op budgets hold; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-20' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: v0.21 world graphics pass - per-map ground decor, layered trees, shaded rocks and lit building windows, fading scorch decals, player rim/overdrive and boss ground auras

impact_assessment.why: After v0.20 the atmosphere and combat feedback read well, but screenshots still showed empty ground between props, flat trees and rocks, unlit window holes, explosions that vanished without a trace, and weak player/boss presence against the terrain
impact_assessment.benefits: Each map gets a distinct ground-detail identity, props gain depth and inhabited details, explosions leave spatial history, and the player and bosses read more clearly without changing gameplay
impact_assessment.risks: contract: render helpers gain non-solid decor and decal state, snapshot gains a read-only decals count, no save schema or mechanics change; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: decals capped and transient
impact_assessment.mitigation: Place decor by hash so the seeded gameplay stream is unchanged, keep decor non-solid, cap and fade decals, test per-map decor kinds and decal lifecycle, rerun the full suite and draw budgets, capture fresh screenshots, then run python aikit.py check dustline

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Map decor complete: deterministic non-solid 210px decor fields with desert grass/bones/pebbles, frost snowgrass/ice/pebbles, ash charred stumps/bones/ember cracks, and jungle ferns/flowers/mushrooms; each cluster has wind sway and is drawn under props/entities

[3/4] Prop and presence pass complete: layered tree canopies with sway, shaded faceted rocks, building roof overhangs/plinth/door step/warm windows, a capped 12-slot nine-second scorch decal pool from explosions, player rim light plus overdrive ring and boss ground aura; decor/explode seams and snapshot.decals added; 123/123 tests pass

[4/4] Verification complete: 123/123 tests pass, python aikit.py check dustline reports 5/5 gates, and fresh captures (85-world-*, 86-scorch-decal, 88-boss-aura, 89-overdrive-rim, 91-decor-*) plus the v0.21 contact sheet confirm per-map decor, layered props, scorch decals, player rim/overdrive and boss auras; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-21' completed successfully.
